title.zh: Vitalik Buterin Pushes Ethereum Plan to Slash Quantum-Safe Privacy Costs
title.en: Vitalik Buterin Pushes Ethereum Plan to Slash Quantum-Safe Privacy Costs

current_state.zh: Vitalik Buterin is pushing EIP-8288, a draft proposal that would bundle quantum-resistant signatures and STARK proofs into a single proof per Ethereum block, potentially reducing quantum-safe private transaction costs from about 10 million gas to tens of thousands.
